newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BONDS STEADY, IGNORE BUDGET, ECON DATA.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BONDS STEADY, IGNORE BUDGET, ECON DATA.

text.p: Bonds were mostly stable on
Friday tracking Bunds as the market shrugged off news of a
tighter than expected Finnish 1998 bugdet and also ignored
in-line domestic economic indicators, dealers said.
"No impact at all -- the Finnish-German link seems to be
tight," one dealer said. The long-end yield spread over Bunds
was steady around 20 basis points.
"Good news, but it will not really affect the market," said
another, referring to the government's budget proposal with
total spending and the deficit below targets set by the finance
ministry.
"But this can of course affect the rate hike schedule of the
Bank of Finland," she said, adding that she thought the budget,
although slightly tighter, left austerity on the Bank of
Finland's shoulders. "But this has been discounted in FRAs
already earlier," she added.
U.S. in-line CPI data reported on Thursday lent a positive
tone to the market, dealers said, "I expect the favurable tone
to continue," a dealer said.
Dealers could not pinpoint any coming events expected to
change the atmosphere.
